title: Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040) (2025), Itemized Deductions

passages.question: How much state and local tax can a joint return deduct for 2025?
passages.excerpt: The overall limit on the deduction for state and local income, sales, and property taxes has increased to $40,000 ($20,000 if married filing separately). The overall limit is reduced if your modified adjusted gross income is more than $500,000 ... but will not be reduced below $10,000 ... Multiply line 6 by 30% (0.30).

passages.question: Can Washington residents deduct general sales tax, and how?
passages.excerpt: If you elect to deduct state and local general sales taxes instead of income taxes, you must check the box on line 5a. To figure your state and local general sales tax deduction, you can use either your actual expenses or the optional sales tax tables.

passages.question: Is all of the mortgage interest deductible?
passages.excerpt: For qualifying debt taken out after December 15, 2017, you can only deduct home mortgage interest on up to $750,000 ($375,000 if you are married filing separately) of that debt.
